subject: Power BI: Refresh failed for 'Orders Daily Rollup' - gateway unavailable (3rd consecutive failure)
body:

GatewayError: The on-premises data gateway 'gw-onprem-01' did not respond. The gateway may be offline or unable to reach the source. RequestId: b71fc2a5-8e04-4d63-9a12-7c5e10bd3f6a
